headline: Sumeet Bagadia recommends buying HDFC Life, Cummins India, and CG Power
hook: Expert picks three setups for the week
summary: Analyst Sumeet Bagadia has recommended three stock picks for retail traders, highlighting HDFC Life, Cummins India, and CG Power with specific targets and stoplosses.
